logic.q: Does conditional logic really run on the public form?
logic.a: Yes. The rules decide the next question, hide the ones that make no sense and the progress bar counts only reachable questions.

export.q: Can I take the responses to a spreadsheet?
export.a: The Export button builds a CSV in the browser itself, with one column per question plus date, duration, source and contact columns.

brand.q: Can I use my own brand?
brand.a: The Appearance tab changes the accent color, the cover and the closing message of each form.

limits.q: Is there a limit of questions?
limits.a: No. The builder takes as many questions as you want, and the draggable list stays easy to reorder.

privacy.q: Where does this demo keep its data?
privacy.a: Everything runs in the browser: forms and responses live in local storage and can be restored from settings.

footer.tagline: Form and survey builder with conditional logic, computed results and CSV export.
